Extracts full Open Graph metadata from a page

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(null);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url);
        System.out.println(result.statusCode());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().ogTitle());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().ogType());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().ogImage());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().ogDescription());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().title());
    }
}
```
